knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = normalizePath(file.path(getwd(), "..", "..")))

Original analysis of the submitted manuscript (Fig. 2): near-homoplasmic
mtDNA variants vs all other samples, design `~ comp_3`.

* Sequencing: Illumina, 150 bp paired-end
* QC: FastQC, MultiQC; trimming: cutadapt
* Quantification: Salmon against GENCODE GRCh38.p13; gene-level counts with tximport
* Differential expression: DESeq2
* Enrichment: clusterProfiler / ReactomePA

```{r libraries, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
source("R/00_config.R")

library(DESeq2)
library(tidyverse)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(pheatmap)
library(tximport)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
library(readxl)
library(edgeR)
library(EDASeq)
library(org.Hs.eg.db)
library(AnnotationDbi)
library(clusterProfiler)
library(ReactomePA)
library(pathview)
```

## Import counts and metadata

```{r import, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
samples <- list.files(path = salmon_dir, full.names = TRUE, pattern = "B_")
files_B <- file.path(samples, "quant.sf")
names(files_B) <- gsub(".*\\/B_(\\d+)_.*", "B_\\1", files_B)

samples <- list.files(path = salmon_dir, full.names = TRUE, pattern = "C_")
files_C <- file.path(samples, "quant.sf")
## the first 24 C_ folders belong to a different project and are not part of this cohort
files_C <- files_C[-c(1:24)]
names(files_C) <- gsub(".*\\/C_(\\d+)_.*", "C_\\1", files_C)

files   <- c(files_B, files_C)
tx2gene <- read.delim(tx2gene_path)

txi   <- tximport(files, type = "salmon", tx2gene = tx2gene[, c(1, 3)])
txi_c <- round(txi$counts)
data  <- txi_c
colSums(data)

meta_data <- read_excel(sample_list, sheet = "Foglio2")
meta_data <- meta_data[-39, ]          # C_39 excluded (low sequencing quality)
meta_data <- as.data.frame(meta_data)
meta_data <- meta_data[order(meta_data$`Sample Name`), ]

se <- SummarizedExperiment(assays = list(counts = data), colData = meta_data)
table(rowSums(assay(se)) > 0)

## low-count filter: mean count >= 10
filter <- rowMeans(assay(se)) >= 10
table(filter)
filtered <- se[filter, ]
filtered
```

## DESeq2

```{r deseq2, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromTximport(txi, colData = meta_data, ~ comp_3)

## C_34 removed (low sequencing quality)
dds  <- dds[, dds$`Sample Name` != "C_34"]
keep <- rowMeans(counts(dds)) >= 10
dds  <- dds[keep, ]

dds <- DESeq(dds)
cbind(resultsNames(dds))
res <- results(dds, name = "comp_3_WT_vs_MUT", alpha = 0.05)
table(dds$comp_3)
summary(res)
```

## Sample QC: library sizes, RLE, normalisation comparison

```{r qc, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
se_qc <- SummarizedExperiment(assays = list(counts = counts(dds)), colData = colData(dds))

pal <- brewer.pal(8, "Set2")
barplot(colSums(assay(se_qc)), las = 2, col = pal[as.factor(se_qc$comp_3)], cex.axis = 0.75)
legend("topleft", levels(as.factor(se_qc$comp_3)), pch = 19, col = pal[1:2], bty = "n")

plotRLE(assay(se_qc), col = pal[as.factor(se_qc$comp_3)], outline = FALSE, las = 2, cex.axis = 0.75)
plotPCA(assay(se_qc), col = pal[as.factor(se_qc$comp_3)], cex.axis = 0.75)

assay(se_qc, "uq") <- betweenLaneNormalization(assay(se_qc), which = "upper")
assay(se_qc, "fq") <- betweenLaneNormalization(assay(se_qc), which = "full")
tmm_factors <- calcNormFactors(assay(se_qc), method = "TMM")
assay(se_qc, "tmm") <- cpm(assay(se_qc), lib.size = tmm_factors * colSums(assay(se_qc)))
rle_factors <- calcNormFactors(assay(se_qc), method = "RLE")
assay(se_qc, "rle") <- cpm(assay(se_qc), lib.size = rle_factors * colSums(assay(se_qc)))

for (a in c("counts", "uq", "fq", "tmm", "rle")) {
  plotRLE(assay(se_qc, a), las = 2, outline = FALSE, main = a, cex.axis = 0.75,
          col = pal[as.factor(se_qc$comp_3)])
}
for (a in c("counts", "uq", "fq", "tmm", "rle")) {
  plotPCA(assay(se_qc, a), main = a, cex.axis = 0.75, col = pal[as.factor(se_qc$comp_3)])
}
```

## Differentially expressed genes

DEG definition: `padj < 0.05` and `|log2FC| > 0.6`. Note that the contrast is
`WT_vs_MUT`, i.e. positive log2FC = higher in WT (the sign is flipped to MUT vs WT
in the figure script).

```{r deg, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
geni_de <- as.data.frame(res)
geni_de <- na.omit(geni_de[geni_de$padj < 0.05, ])
geni_de$type <- ifelse(geni_de$log2FoldChange < 0, "downregulated", "upregulated")
geni_de$symbol <- mapIds(org.Hs.eg.db, rownames(geni_de), "SYMBOL", "ENSEMBL")
write.csv(geni_de, file.path(results_dir, "DEG_WT_vs_MUT_padj005.csv"))

table(res$pvalue <= 0.05)
table(res$padj <= 0.05)

rld <- rlog(dds)
vsd <- vst(dds)
```

## Volcano plot

```{r volcano}
res_df <- as.data.frame(res)
res_df$diffexpressed <- "Not sig"
res_df$diffexpressed[res_df$log2FoldChange >  0.6 & res_df$padj < 0.05] <- "Up"
res_df$diffexpressed[res_df$log2FoldChange < -0.6 & res_df$padj < 0.05] <- "Down"

ggplot(res_df, aes(x = log2FoldChange, y = -log10(padj), col = diffexpressed)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("#4F9BF2", "#BEBEBE", "#BF011D")) +
  labs(col = "") + xlim(-7, 7) + ylim(0, 4) +
  geom_point(size = 1.5) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 15)
```

## PCA

```{r pca, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
for (obj in list(rlog = rld, vst = vsd)) {
  pcaData <- plotPCA(obj, intgroup = "comp_3", returnData = TRUE)
  percentVar <- round(100 * attr(pcaData, "percentVar"))
  pcaData$sample <- dds$`Sample Name`
  print(
    ggplot(pcaData, aes(PC1, PC2, colour = as.character(comp_3))) +
      geom_point(size = 2.5) + theme_bw() + labs(color = "comp_3") +
      geom_text_repel(aes(label = sample), size = 3) +
      xlab(paste0("PC1: ", percentVar[1], "% variance")) +
      ylab(paste0("PC2: ", percentVar[2], "% variance"))
  )
}
ggsave(file.path(figures_dir, "PCA_vst_WT_vs_MUT.png"), width = 12, height = 9, dpi = 300)
```

## Gene identifiers for enrichment

Gene IDs are mapped from `rownames(res)` so that names and statistics are
guaranteed to be in the same order. (An earlier version mapped the IDs from
`rownames(filtered)`, which is filtered on all samples *before* removing C_34,
while `res` is filtered *after*: the two gene lists are aligned only if the
filter keeps exactly the same genes - checked below.)

```{r ids, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
cat("rownames(filtered) identical to rownames(res):",
    identical(rownames(filtered), rownames(res)), "\n")

ids  <- mapIds(org.Hs.eg.db, rownames(res), "ENTREZID", "ENSEMBL")
ids2 <- mapIds(org.Hs.eg.db, rownames(filtered), "SYMBOL", "ENSEMBL")  # used by xCell

pv_2 <- res$padj;  names(pv_2) <- ids    # ORA input: genes with padj <= 0.15
tt   <- res$stat;  names(tt)   <- ids    # GSEA input: Wald statistic
```

## Over-representation analysis (genes with padj <= 0.15)

```{r ora_go, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
for (ont in c("BP", "CC", "MF")) {
  ego <- enrichGO(gene = ids[which(pv_2 <= 0.15)], universe = ids, OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db,
                  ont = ont, pAdjustMethod = "BH", pvalueCutoff = 0.15, qvalueCutoff = 0.15,
                  readable = TRUE)
  if (nrow(as.data.frame(ego)) > 0) print(barplot(ego, showCategory = 20) + ggtitle(paste("GO", ont)))
}
```

```{r ora_kegg, fig.height=16, fig.width=20, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
kk <- enrichKEGG(gene = ids[which(pv_2 <= 0.15)], universe = ids,
                 organism = "hsa", pvalueCutoff = 0.15)
kegg_final <- read.csv(kegg_categories, sep = "")
k2 <- merge(kk@result, kegg_final, by = "ID", all.x = TRUE)
k2 <- k2[k2$p.adjust < 0.15, ]
ggplot(k2, aes(x = Count / 324, y = fct_reorder(Description, Count / 324))) +
  geom_point(aes(size = Count, color = p.adjust)) + theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  scale_colour_gradient(limits = c(0, 0.20), low = "purple") +
  ylab(NULL) + xlab("GeneRatio") + ggtitle("KEGG enrichment")
```

```{r ora_reactome, fig.height=16, fig.width=20, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
x <- enrichPathway(gene = ids[which(pv_2 <= 0.15)], pvalueCutoff = 0.15, readable = TRUE)
reactome_final <- read.csv(reactome_categories, sep = "")
z <- merge(x@result, reactome_final, by = "ID", all.x = TRUE)
z <- z[z$p.adjust < 0.15, ]
ggplot(z, aes(x = Count / 460, y = fct_reorder(Description, Count / 460))) +
  geom_point(aes(size = Count, color = p.adjust)) + theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  scale_colour_gradient(limits = c(0, 0.20), low = "purple") +
  ylab(NULL) + xlab("GeneRatio") + ggtitle("Reactome enrichment")
```

## GSEA (genes ranked by the DESeq2 Wald statistic)

```{r gsea_go, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
for (ont in c("BP", "CC", "MF")) {
  ego2 <- gseGO(geneList = sort(tt[!is.na(names(tt))], decreasing = TRUE), ont = ont,
                OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db, minGSSize = 100, maxGSSize = 500, pvalueCutoff = 0.25)
  if (nrow(as.data.frame(ego2)) > 0)
    print(dotplot(ego2, showCategory = 10, split = ".sign", font.size = 7) +
            facet_grid(. ~ .sign) + ggtitle(paste("GSEA GO", ont)))
}
```

```{r gsea_kegg, fig.height=14, fig.width=20, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
geneList <- sort(tt[!is.na(names(tt)) & !duplicated(names(tt))], decreasing = TRUE)

set.seed(1)
kk2 <- gseKEGG(geneList = geneList, organism = "hsa",
               minGSSize = 10, maxGSSize = 1000, pvalueCutoff = 0.35)
write.csv(as.data.frame(kk2), file.path(results_dir, "GSEA_KEGG_WT_vs_MUT.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
dotplot(kk2, showCategory = 30, split = ".sign") + facet_grid(. ~ .sign)

## Pathview maps used in the figures (OXPHOS, TCA cycle)
old_wd <- setwd(figures_dir)
for (pid in c("hsa00190", "hsa00020")) {
  pathview(gene.data = geneList, pathway.id = pid, species = "hsa",
           limit = list(gene = max(abs(geneList)), cpd = 1))
}
setwd(old_wd)
```

```{r gsea_reactome, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
set.seed(123)
pw2 <- gsePathway(geneList = geneList, organism = "human", exponent = 1,
                  minGSSize = 10, maxGSSize = 1000, pvalueCutoff = 0.35,
                  pAdjustMethod = "BH", verbose = TRUE)
write.csv(as.data.frame(pw2), file.path(results_dir, "GSEA_Reactome_WT_vs_MUT.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
dotplot(pw2, showCategory = 10, split = ".sign", font.size = 8) + facet_grid(. ~ .sign)
```
